title: Cruising speed: ISS orbit vs. a commercial jet
notes: NASA lists the ISS's orbital speed at roughly 17,500 mph (about 27,600 km/h), circling Earth about every 90 minutes. A typical commercial jet cruises around 560 mph (about 900 km/h) -- the ISS moves roughly 30 times faster. Values converted here to km/h for on-screen consistency.
